thread:
alex_dev: quick thought — our postmortem actions keep aging. propose a lightweight scoreboard + SLA for remediations.

riley_sre: what SLA are you imagining?

alex_dev: small: Stage 1 = 5 business days (triage + quick mitigation), Stage 2 = 15 business days (full fix + verification). after Stage 2 miss -> escalate.

jamie_pm: 5/15 seems reasonable for small infra issues. can we auto-tag urgency so big customer-facing items get shorter windows?

alex_dev: yes: tags: severity/high -> 3/7, medium -> 5/15, low -> 10/30. owner must pick severity when creating remediation ticket.

tara_oncall: must include a verification checklist in the ticket before Stage 2 close. no verification -> cannot close.

ops-bot: automated: will reject Stage 2 close if "verification" field empty. weekly scoreboard posted Mon 09:00 to #eng-oncall.

riley_sre: add recurrence counter on the ticket. if service has >=3 remediations in 60 days, auto-escalate to eng-sre and ping product.

alex_dev: I sketched a tiny ticket template for slash command `/remediate`:
```
title: <short summary>
owner: @<user>
severity: high|medium|low
due_stage1: YYYY-MM-DD
due_stage2: YYYY-MM-DD
mitigation: 1 line
verification: steps to run smoke
recurrence: yes/no
incident_link: <url>
tags: remediation/scoreboard
```

jamie_pm: comms cadence: owners post a 1-line update in the incident thread every 72h until Stage 2 closes. keeps stakeholders in the loop without heavy meetings.

tara_oncall: weekly 20-min remediation sync (optional async notes). facilitator rotates with IC rotation. new IC shadows first week then leads second week.

riley_sre: metric to track: % of remediations past Stage 2 overdue. target <10% within 4-week pilot.

alex_dev: i'll prototype the slash command and a tiny webhook that tags scoreboard items. aiming to launch pilot next Monday.

ops-bot: note: pilot kickoff reminder scheduled and scoreboard digest enabled.

jamie_pm: can someone own pilot coordination and follow-ups? want a 4-week checkpoint and a short retro.

tara_oncall: i'll coordinate pilot for 3 weeks, collect scoreboard data, and run the retro. tagging @alex_dev for the slash and @riley_sre for recurrence rules.

alex_dev: thanks — i'll open the tracking ticket and post link here when created.

riley_sre: if scoreboard shows >2 stale items after 2 weeks, we'll increase review cadence to twice weekly.

jamie_pm: :thumbsup: thanks all — lightweight, measurable, and gives owners clear expectations.
